name: comp-55
title: Timestamp Masked Input
blurb: Time input with automatic HH:MM:SS formatting mask.
description: An input with use-mask-input applying the pattern 99:99:99 for time format. User types digits and colons are inserted automatically.
use_when: Time entry fields that need consistent HH:MM:SS formatting.
avoid_when: You need a native time picker or different time format.
a11y: Label linked to input. Mask is transparent. Placeholder shows expected format.
